description: Header file defining the GpuVideoDecoderBase class for a platform-specific GPU video decoder, including nested classes for frame buffers and decoded images, with methods for initialization, decoding, buffer management, and error handling.

classes.name: GpuVideoDecoderBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for GPU video decoding, managing platform-specific resources, buffer pools, and decoding workflow.

classes.name: GpuVideoDecoderBase::GpuFrameBuffer
classes.description: Represents a GPU frame buffer with textures and resources for decoding output.

classes.name: GpuVideoDecoderBase::DecodedImage
classes.description: Represents a decoded video image with associated textures, metadata, and release callback.

methods.name: GpuVideoDecoderBase::ReleaseFrameBuffer
methods.description: Releases or recycles a frame buffer.

methods.name: GpuVideoDecoderBase::GetWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the current frame.

methods.name: GpuVideoDecoderBase::GetHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the current frame.

methods.name: GpuVideoDecoderBase::IsHdrVideo
methods.description: Indicates if the video is HDR.

methods.name: GpuVideoDecoderBase::ClearFrameBuffersPool
methods.description: Clears the pool of frame buffers.

methods.name: GpuVideoDecoderBase::AllocateFrameBuffers
methods.description: Allocates textures and resources for frames.

methods.name: GpuVideoDecoderBase::GetAvailableFrameBuffer
methods.description: Gets an available frame buffer matching size.
